format.record: FF lo hi = mirrored alias; 00 = empty; N M {frames}: N sprites/frame, mask M
format.frame_select: f = ($04E0,X >> 3) & M  (anim counter; frame changes every 8 counts)
format.sprite: [dx s8, dy s8 (OAM y = sy+dy, shown +1), attr, tile]; dx=$80 ends a frame
format.tile: final tile = (tile + $0320,X + ($0380 b5 ? $40 : 0)) & $FF; CHR 1KB bank = chr[tile>>6]
format.chr: [R2,R3,R4,R5]; R2=$40 player, R3=$41+clamp(sword,1..5) (start: $42), R4/R5 per area
format.palettes: sprite pal 0..3 = ids [$07E4=0, $07E5=sword(1), e6, e7] -> slot (id+$B0)&$FF; colour 0 transparent
